title: Fry Bread
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Pani (Water) lukewarm ½ Cup or as required

steps.instruction: In bowl,add all-purpose flour,caster sugar,salt,baking powder and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein maida,bareek cheeni,namak aur baking powder dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.
Oil dal ker mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add lukewarm water and knead until dough is formed,cover and let it rest for 1 hour.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka neem garam pani shamil karein aur ghond ker dough tayyar ker lein aur dhak ker 1 hour kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Add oil and knead dough again.
steps.romanUrdu: Oil dal ker dubara ghond lein.

steps.instruction: Take a small dough and make a ball,sprinkle dry flour and rolled out with the help of rolling pin.
steps.romanUrdu: Chota dough lein aur ball bana lein,maida chirak ker rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein.
Fork ki madad sa prick ker lein (makes 6-8).

steps.instruction: In frying pan,add heat cooking oil and fry dough from both sides until golden brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein cooking oil garam karein aur dough ko dono sides sa golden brown hunay tak fry ker lein.

ogDescription: Delicious fry bread recipe. Serve with your favorite topping. Perfect for breakfast or brunch. #HappyCookingToYou
